info.title: MillTrack
info.description: Every endpoint except /auth/login requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from that login call. Every error response — from FastAPI's own validation, a router's HTTPException, or a translated Postgres error below — is shaped `{"detail": ...}`; only automatic request-body validation errors (422) use FastAPI's standard field-level `detail` array instead of a plain string, per the FastAPI convention API consumers already expect.

tags.description: Gateman: log every vehicle in/out. Create+read only, matching the paper gate-pass model.

tags.name: supervisor
tags.description: Production Supervisor: twice-daily shift logs (O/E, CARD, Draw Frame) and the independent ~20h DOFF cycle.

tags.name: packaging
